summary: M4 (Biometric device push + AI Assistant) tested end-to-end. Backend: 18/19 pytest cases passing. Biometric devices CRUD, ACL, duplicate-serial 400, secret-hiding on GET/POST responses, wrong-secret 401, unknown employee 404, checkout-before-checkin 400, first push creates check_in, second push creates check_out, device last_seen/status update, logs contain rejected+accepted entries. Owner delete works. AI Assistant: Gemini 3 Flash returns valid answers ('6 employees', mentions RMJ001 for Rahul), employee login gets 403, history endpoint returns saved Q&A. FAILING (1): GET /api/attendance/today does NOT reflect a biometric push for RMJ005 — root cause is a TIMEZONE MISMATCH: /api/biometric/push stores attendance with date=IST (`ist.date().isoformat()`), while /api/attendance/today queries with date=UTC (`date.today().isoformat()`). This will silently break attendance visibility any time the IST date differs from the UTC date (00:00–05:30 UTC daily). Frontend: Dashboard has 'Ask AI' pill (ai-assistant-btn) top-right; tapping opens assistant-screen with title 'RMJ AI', suggestions, and working input/send; Gemini reply rendered as assistant bubble. Settings→'Biometric Devices' (settings-biometric-btn) opens biometric-screen with DEVICES/LOGS tabs — devices tab shows push URL, register form (dev-serial/dev-label/dev-secret/add-device-btn) and registered device list with delete; logs tab lists all sync events with accepted/rejected states and reason.

critical.issue: Timezone mismatch: biometric push writes attendance with date=IST (ist.date() at server.py:1763), but /api/attendance/today filters by date=UTC (date.today() at server.py:646 via today_str at server.py:48-49). Any push that lands in the 00:00-05:30 UTC window creates an attendance row that /attendance/today cannot see, silently dropping the punch from the dashboard. Fix: standardise both endpoints on the same 'business day' (recommend IST since store operates IST). Update today_str() to return IST date, or make /attendance/today compute IST date, and update _build_context in the assistant similarly.

action_items: Fix timezone mismatch between biometric push (IST) and attendance/today (UTC) so device-pushed check_in/check_out appears immediately in dashboard/today endpoint (server.py:48 today_str vs server.py:1763 ist date). Recommended: switch today_str to IST since the entire store operates IST (work_start/grace_min already IST).

OPTIONAL: add tabBarTestID to Tabs.Screen entries in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (dashboard/attendance/employees/payroll/settings) — currently there is no testID on bottom tab items, forcing tests to key off English labels which will break if the app is ever localised.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has crossed 1,900 lines — biometric + assistant should be split into modules (/backend/routers/biometric.py, /backend/routers/assistant.py). Not blocking.

biometric_push writes attendance without going through the shared check_in/check_out helpers used by app-based punches, so any future changes to punch logic (e.g. shift resolution, holiday handling) must be duplicated. Consider factoring _apply_punch(emp, kind, timestamp, source, device_serial) to keep them in sync.

Assistant _build_context() concatenates every employee + every closing-balance into the system prompt on every call — O(N) DB reads per question. Cache the snapshot for e.g. 30s or move to a real tool-calling flow for scale.
Assistant returns HTTP 502 on Gemini errors — fine — but there is no timeout on the SDK call; a slow Gemini call will hold the request open. Consider asyncio.wait_for(20s).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (owner login → dashboard → Ask AI → Gemini answer → Settings → Biometric Devices → devices/logs tabs → add device via UI, verified list update)

seed_data_creation: Test devices with serials TEST-SN-* and UI-SN-* were registered; one was deleted by test_owner_deletes, the rest remain. Biometric logs for RMJ005/RMJ999 (accepted and rejected) remain in DB and are visible in the Logs tab. RMJ005 has a biometric-created attendance row for the current IST date.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M4 backend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). /api/biometric/push is UNAUTHENTICATED (device serial+secret pair). Assistant uses Emergent LLM key + emergentintegrations LlmChat.with_model('gemini','gemini-3-flash-preview'). Pytest suite in test_m4.py must run with `-n 0` because TestBiometricDevices and TestBiometricPush share class-level device serial/secret state — under xdist loadscope they land on different workers and the push tests will hit the DB before the device row exists. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_m4.py -n 0. The single failing test test_attendance_today_reflects_push is the real timezone-mismatch bug reported above, not a test-suite issue.
rca_of_issue: Bug: biometric-pushed attendance vanishes from /attendance/today when IST and UTC dates differ. Reproduction: push a biometric event via POST /api/biometric/push between 18:31 UTC and 23:59 UTC (which is next-day IST). Server writes attendance with date=IST(next-day). GET /api/attendance/today filters by date=UTC(today), so the row is invisible. Confirmed at 18:51 UTC = 00:21 IST during this test — RMJ005 punch created attendance date=2026-08-08, but /attendance/today?date=2026-08-07(UTC) returned check_in=null. Mitigation: change today_str() to return IST date (astimezone to +05:30 then .date()), or accept both dates in queries. Because store hours (work_start/grace_min) are already IST-relative, aligning the day boundary to IST is the correct fix. Files: /app/backend/server.py lines 44-49 (today_str, now_utc) and 1758-1763 (biometric push IST derivation) and 646 (attendance/today uses today_str).
